entities.title: clean::shrink has no caller left
entities.summary: Since the MCP proxy and `zazzle run` moved to clean::shrink_steps, clean::shrink is called only by its own test, and its comment still names the proxy as its caller.
entities.compromise: shrink was kept beside the new shrink_steps (which also returns the steps, so callers can tell whether anything was cut) instead of being removed; its comment says it is for "callers other than the command line such as the MCP proxy", which no longer holds.
entities.cost: A public function and a test to keep in step with clean, and a comment that points a reader at a caller that does not use it.
acceptanceCriteria: clean::shrink is removed with its test, or has a caller again and a comment that names it.
`cargo test -p zazzled` and the branch-coverage gate still pass.

origin.by: Coding agent reconciling the zazzled .dev files with commit 5ea503c
